choice_requirements: The value satisfies the executable pipeline contract.
The value is compatible with known dataset metadata, including the Nyquist limit.
At least one cited explicit observation normalizes to the selected executable value.
The investigator supplies a rationale and confirms the choice.
persistence: The project parameter record stores the decision id, evidence ids and corpus version.
The method decision stores the exact evidence snapshot used at decision time.
Changing a parameter invalidates the previous project validation.
The execution plan exposes the resolved records and their decision provenance.
New resolved choices store selection_audit atomically with the parameter and immutable method decision.
The audit freezes all candidates and assessments reconstructed at resolution time, context, corpus and contract hashes, exact citations and cited alternative values.
Hashes check audit and citation content consistency. They do not certify extraction accuracy or scientific validity.
Recorded context or executable contract changes require a new documented choice for audited decisions.
Legacy decisions retain their previous provenance checks and selection_audit_status=legacy_unavailable; no audit is invented retrospectively.

guidance_assessment.scope: All observations mapped to the executable parameter, including inferred and unreported records.
guidance_assessment.option_limit: Applies only to options; options_truncated identifies omitted options.
guidance_assessment.counts: Observation counts and unique paper counts are descriptive; neither measures evidence strength.
guidance_assessment.normalization: Expected units, unambiguous scalar or Hz interval, preserved signs and finite values only.
